## Context
- This prerequisite story enables the two-stage safe promotion for epic 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86 and voting story d645-8f51-0ff9-4070.
- `gerrit-verify.yaml` is dispatched from `main`, so DAG-level changes in a patchset do not run on their own introducing change. Enforcing scanner-integration in the same change that adds its job would recreate the incident-90c7 vacuous-vote class.
- Stage A therefore lands only an auto-running advisory scanner job. Once this invoker is on `main`, Stage B can observe the scanner job executing on Stage B's own patchset before flipping it into the voting aggregate.

## Scope
- Add a concrete `scanner-integration` job inside `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`, gated to the full route like build-and-test/optionality, calling `./.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml` with Gerrit refspec/project/url so it scans the exact patchset automatically. Invert the two existing tests that currently assert the job is absent from `gerrit-verify.yaml`: `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py::test_scanner_integration_runs_full_route_but_is_advisory` and `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py::test_scanner_workflow_is_shared_by_mirror_and_gerrit_advisory` must now assert the job exists and carries the full-route `if:` plus Gerrit patchset inputs while remaining absent from `vote.needs` and vote normalization.
- Keep the job advisory in Stage A: do not add it to `vote.needs`, do not reference it in vote normalization, and do not remove the `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` ADR-0114 advisory exception yet. Because `im-open/workflow-conclusion` observes all jobs in the run, Stage A must also change the vote normalize `CONCLUSION` expression so success is derived from the explicit required-route `needs.*.result` checks (`'success'` when the docs-only or full required route is complete, otherwise `'failure'`) instead of passing through `env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION`. The scanner job is not in `vote.needs`, so its failure/cancellation/timeout is visible in the run but cannot cast Verified -1 while advisory; required reusable job failures still block because their `needs.<job>.result` is not `success`. Add a Stage-A test that the normalize expression no longer contains `env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION` and still excludes `needs.scanner-integration`.
- Keep the existing manual `gerrit-scanner-verify.yml` workflow as an on-demand operator probe; the new required evidence for Stage A is that a subsequent real patchset run shows the Gerrit Verified workflow contains a `scanner-integration` job that executes and passes.
- Update only Stage-A tests and docs needed to distinguish advisory auto-run from voting enforcement. Concretely: invert `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py::test_scanner_integration_runs_full_route_but_is_advisory` and `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py::test_scanner_workflow_is_shared_by_mirror_and_gerrit_advisory` to assert the job now exists in `gerrit-verify.yaml` while still absent from `vote.needs` and normalize; add `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_scanner_gate_uses_one_reusable_in_both_lanes_and_stays_advisory`; and add `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` coverage that computes `_workflow_closure((".github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml",))` and asserts `.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml` is reachable from the Gerrit root alone. Stage B remains responsible for parity-exception reversal, voting aggregation, and ADR-0114 supersession.

## Anti-90c7 safety design
- No enforcement changes land in Stage A, so a scanner failure cannot block all merges while the auto-run invoker is being introduced.
- Empirical GHA proof is required after Stage A lands: observe a real Gerrit patchset Verified run from `main` with `scanner-integration` present, executed, and passing. Record the run URL/job id on this ticket and on d645 before starting Stage B submit decisions.
- Portability remains through the existing portable `make scanner-integration` target and `_scanner-integration.yml` wrapper; Stage A introduces no bash-only Make recipe and no GitHub-only scanner implementation.

## Testing
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py::test_scanner_workflow_is_shared_by_mirror_and_gerrit_advisory -q` proves the scanner job is auto-run from `gerrit-verify.yaml`, remains out of `vote.needs` and vote normalization, the vote normalize expression ignores all-run `env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION` while deriving success from explicit required-route results, and `_workflow_closure((".github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml",))` reaches `_scanner-integration.yml` from the Gerrit root alone (not merely through `test.yml`).
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` must still pass with `scanner-integration` excluded as advisory.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint && env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck` proves repo gates remain green.
- Sandboxed mutation removes the advisory scanner job from `gerrit-verify.yaml` and confirms the held-out tests fail, then restores.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Newly-added assertions in `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`, plus inverted assertions in `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py` and `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py::test_scanner_workflow_is_shared_by_mirror_and_gerrit_advisory`, prove `gerrit-verify.yaml` contains a full-route advisory `scanner-integration` job using `_scanner-integration.yml` with Gerrit patchset inputs; these are Stage-A coverage updates.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py` proves Stage A keeps `scanner-integration` out of `vote.needs` and out of vote normalization, and proves the normalize expression derives `CONCLUSION` from explicit required-route `needs.*.result` checks without `env.WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION`, so the advisory scanner job cannot cast Verified -1 through the all-run conclusion.
- [x] `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` still passes with `scanner-integration` documented in `EXCLUDED_JOBS` as the temporary Stage-A advisory exception.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` includes an assertion over `_workflow_closure((".github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml",))` proving the auto-running scanner reusable is reachable from the Gerrit-only Verified workflow closure, so future patchsets exercise it from `main` independently of the existing mirror `test.yml` scanner job.
- [x] `make lint && make typecheck` pass locally with `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- [x] [non-codebase] After Stage A lands, a ticket comment records the real GHA run URL/job id showing `scanner-integration` executed and passed on a Gerrit patchset before Stage B enforcement is submitted.
      provenance: environment=github-actions runner (navapbc/rebar, gerrit-verify.yaml dispatched from main); principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — queried the GitHub Actions API for run 34005589010 (change 2704 patchset 1, created 2026-09-06T02:05:59Z, after Stage A merged as ea08483d825e at 00:47:30Z) and read job `scanner-integration (pinned Semgrep + Gitleaks on the patchset)`, id 101412298454, status=completed conclusion=success. Control: run 34001920346 (created 00:40:46Z, 6m44s BEFORE the merge) enumerates 21 jobs and contains no scanner-integration job, so the job's presence is attributable to Stage A landing rather than pre-existing. This is a read-only observation of the real production CI system; no privileged mutation was required or performed.
